keywords: Verification process 2.Effectiveness 3.Acceptability 4.Data handling skills 5.Credibility PBL for science and technology
educationalGoal: -To gain skills to verify hypotheses or solution concept with logical approaches. -To understand phenomena, objects, and events quantitatively with high credibility. -To reliably find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objects, events. -To deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. -To gain basic skills to credibly and smoothly conduct verification activities. -To have an image of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.
advice: This is a basic skills course for driving engineering projects. We will cover the following materials: 1. Understand the basic skills for measurements, analysis, verification, and report of the data while learning how to use measuring equipment and its theory. 2. Understand basic skills for improving the authenticity of the measured data through verification processes. The above skills will be obtained through the following basic projects: A. Measurements of AC waveforms using an oscilloscope B. Characteristics of circuit elements under AC waveform supply C. Characteristics of resonance circuits D. Measurements of AC power E. Design of a logic circuit using Digital ICs F. Measurements of static characteristics of a semiconductor device This course also includes an applied project in order to understand how to drive engineering projects by using the obtained basic skills.
books: Design Project / Implementing and Operating of 2024 (Experiment) (Electrical and Electronic Engineering), Kanazawa Institute of Technology
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of electromagnetics and electric circuits. Basic computer skills.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
To be able to find characteristics, features, and laws of phenomena, objects, and events.
To be able to deliver acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
To be able to utilize various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) To proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts. 2) To quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize information. 3) To find and understand features, characteristics, and regularities of corresponding phenomena, objects, and events. 4) To communicate acquired information to a third person intelligibly. 5) To smoothly conduct verification activities. 6) To become aware of your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers.
achievementLevels.standard: 1) To proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts with guidance. 2) To quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize the information with guidance from the instructor. 3) To find and understand characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, etc., with guidance. 4) To share acquired information to third person. 5) To smoothly conduct verification activities with guidance from the instructor. 6) To recognize your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers with guidance.
